articles.title: Mock overdraft protection overview
articles.answer: In this mock policy, overdraft protection can use available funds from an eligible linked savings account when a checking transaction exceeds the checking balance.
articles.disclosure: Fees and eligibility can vary; review the approved account terms.

articles.title: Mock deposit insurance overview
articles.answer: This POC's sample content says eligible deposit accounts are insured subject to the ownership categories and limits stated in the approved account disclosures.
articles.disclosure: This is demonstration content, not a coverage determination.
